name: Doctrine / sacramental teaching
description: Claims about creed, sacraments, liturgy, or magisterial doctrine (e.g. Eucharist, baptism, papal infallibility) presented as teaching.
example_en: The Mass makes present the sacrifice of Christ.
example_es: La Eucaristía es el centro de la vida cristiana.
example_pt: O batismo nos incorpora à Igreja.

name: Catholic social teaching / papal documents
description: Explicit CST themes or named papal/encyclical/apostolic documents (Rerum Novarum, Laudato Si', Fratelli Tutti, Aparecida, etc.).
example_en: Laudato Si' calls for care of our common home.
example_es: Fratelli Tutti habla de la amistad social.
example_pt: Aparecida marca o caminho missionário da Igreja na América Latina.

name: Devotion / popular piety
description: Saints, Marian titles, pilgrimages, rosary, popular religiosity (Guadalupe, Aparecida as devotion, Romero as martyr-devotion).
example_en: Pilgrims walked to the shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe.
example_es: Rezaron el rosario ante la Virgen.
example_pt: Fiéis veneram Nossa Senhora de Aparecida.

name: Moral teaching / ethics
description: Normative claims about personal or social morality (life ethics, sexuality, honesty, preferential option as moral duty) without requiring a named encyclical.
example_en: The Church teaches that every human life has dignity.
example_es: Debemos optar preferencialmente por los pobres.

name: Migration / politics / public controversy
description: Immigration, elections, church–state conflict, protest, or partisan framing involving Catholicism in public debate.
example_en: Bishops urged compassion for migrants at the border.
example_es: La Iglesia criticó la reforma migratoria.

name: Institutional / diocesan / Vatican news
description: Appointments, events, statements, or logistics of Church institutions with little doctrinal or moral teaching content.
example_en: The diocese announced a new cathedral renovation schedule.

name: Evangelization / mission language
description: Mission, new evangelization, proclaiming the Gospel, missionary discipleship (evangelio, misión, evangelização) as the main thrust.
example_en: Parishes are called to missionary discipleship.
example_es: La nueva evangelización pide salir a las periferias.
example_pt: A Igreja é chamada à evangelização permanente.

name: Misunderstanding / misinfo / partial truth
description: Distorted, incomplete, or contradicted Catholic teaching as presented; use together with the content label when possible. Not a verdict of malice—flag for educator review.
example_en: Catholics worship Mary as a goddess.

name: Other / unclear
description: Passage is too thin, purely biographical, or not classifiable into the above; use sparingly when no other label fits.
example_en: He was born in 1932 and later studied abroad.
example_es: Nació en 1932 y después estudió en el extranjero.
example_pt: Nasceu em 1932 e depois estudou no exterior.

name: Factual / descriptive claim
description: Asserts a checkable fact about events, numbers, people, or institutions (who/what/when), without primarily arguing a moral or doctrinal thesis.
example_en: The diocese closed three schools in 2019.
example_es: La diócesis cerró tres escuelas en 2019.
example_pt: A diocese fechou três escolas em 2019.

name: Doctrinal / teaching claim
description: Asserts what the Church teaches or what believers ought to hold as true (creed, sacrament, CST principle) as a claim, not merely reporting that someone said it.
example_en: The Eucharist is the body of Christ.
example_es: La Eucaristía es el cuerpo de Cristo.
example_pt: A Eucaristia é o corpo de Cristo.

name: Question / inquiry
description: Interrogative form or clear asking (¿?, who/what/why, pregunta) directed at the audience or an interlocutor.
example_en: What does preferential option for the poor require of us?
example_es: ¿Qué exige de nosotros la opción preferencial por los pobres?

name: News reporting
description: Journalistic recounting of events or statements (said, according to, announced) with a reporting frame.
example_en: Bishops said the bill would harm migrant families.
example_es: Los obispos dijeron que el proyecto dañaría a familias migrantes.
example_pt: Os bispos disseram que o projeto prejudicaria famílias migrantes.

name: Opinion / editorial
description: Explicit stance, evaluation, or commentary from a speaker/writer voice.
example_en: In my view the parish response was inadequate.

name: Advocacy / exhortation
description: Calls to action, protest, petition, or urging an audience to do something.
example_en: We urge Congress to protect asylum seekers.

name: Homily / prayer / devotion speech
description: Liturgical, prayerful, or preaching register (homily, rosary, blessing) addressed to a faith audience.
example_en: Let us pray for our brothers and sisters on the journey.

name: Interview / dialogue
description: Turn-taking Q&A, quoted interview exchanges, or talk-show style dialogue.
example_en: Host: How has Guadalupe shaped your parish? Guest: …

name: Other / mixed
description: Boilerplate, too short, or mixed acts that do not fit cleanly.
example_en: Tonight's guests discuss parking for the parish festival.
